title: COVID-19, lockdowns and Africa’s informal sector: lessons from Ghana
summary: Using survey data on informal enterprises in Accra and Tema, the paper estimates the likely effects of COVID-19 lockdowns on Ghana's informal sector. Because the lockdown affects business performance, COVID-19 may widen or create gender and spatial gaps in informal enterprise performance.
keyFindings: There is an unexplained spatial gap in sales between informal owners in Accra and Tema.
There is no gender gap in sales or innovation, but there are gender gaps in how firm size affects current sales.
COVID-19 may widen or create gender and spatial gaps in informal enterprise performance.
methods: Survey data on informal enterprises in Accra and Tema, Ghana, with regression analysis.
